channel.title: NurseNow guides
channel.description: NurseNow helps nurses find jobs, get licensed and certified, pass the NCLEX, and grow their careers with free tools, daily-updated news and practical guides.

item.title: AI Tools for Nurses: How to Use Them Safely for Study, Work and Your Career
item.description: Where AI genuinely helps nurses — NCLEX study, explanations, resumes, schedules and admin — the clinical AI your employer may roll out, and the privacy and accuracy rules you must follow.

item.title: Continuing Education for Nurses: CE Hours, CEUs and Licence Renewal Explained
item.description: How continuing education works for nurse licence renewal — contact hours vs CEUs, state requirements in the US, quality-assurance programs in Canada, accredited providers and keeping records.

item.title: Highest-Paying Nursing Jobs and Specialties (BLS Data, Explained)
item.description: What nurses earn by role using US Bureau of Labor Statistics data — CRNA, NP, nurse-midwife, RN and LPN — plus the levers that actually raise your pay and how Canadian nurse pay works.

item.title: How to Become a Nurse in Canada as an Internationally Educated Nurse (Step by Step)
item.description: The real sequence for internationally educated nurses moving to Canada — NNAS, provincial regulators, language tests, bridging, the NCLEX-RN or REx-PN, Québec’s separate path and the immigration track.

item.title: How to Choose a Nursing Specialty: A Decision Framework That Actually Works
item.description: Pick your nursing specialty with a practical framework — pace, acuity, patient population, schedule, skills and pay — plus how to test a specialty before you commit and how to switch later.

item.title: How to Pass the NCLEX on Your First Try: A Realistic 60-Day Plan
item.description: A week-by-week NCLEX-RN and NCLEX-PN study plan for working candidates — daily question targets, how to review rationales, NGN practice and what to do in the final week.

item.title: New Grad Nurse Survival Guide: Your First 90 Days
item.description: A practical plan for your first 90 days as a new graduate nurse — orientation, working with your preceptor, a brain sheet, time management, safe medication habits, SBAR and protecting your wellbeing.

item.title: Next Generation NCLEX Question Types Explained (With Strategies)
item.description: Every NGN item type — case studies, extended multiple response, drag-and-drop, cloze, highlight, matrix, bow-tie and trend — and how to approach each one.

item.title: Night Shift Survival Guide for Nurses: Sleep, Light, Caffeine and Safety
item.description: Evidence-informed strategies for night shift nurses — protecting daytime sleep, timing light and caffeine, strategic naps, eating on nights, drowsy driving and when to talk to a clinician.

item.title: Nurse Burnout: How to Recognise It and Evidence-Based Ways to Recover
item.description: What burnout is (and isn’t), the warning signs nurses miss, individual strategies that help, the workplace changes that matter most, and where to get support.

item.title: The Nurse Licensure Compact Explained: Multistate Licenses in Plain English
item.description: How the Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC) works, who qualifies for a multistate license, primary state of residence rules, what happens when you move, and how telehealth and travel nurses use it.

item.title: Nursing Certifications That Can Raise Your Pay (and How to Choose One)
item.description: Which nursing specialty certifications employers value — CCRN, CEN, PCCN, CMSRN, OCN, CPN, CNOR and Canadian CNA credentials — how certification pay works, and a step-by-step plan to earn one.

item.title: Nursing Interview Questions and Answers: 20 Questions With STAR Examples
item.description: The nursing interview questions you’ll actually be asked — behavioural, clinical and situational — with STAR answer frameworks, example answers and the questions you should ask the unit.

item.title: How to Write a Nursing Resume That Passes ATS and Gets Interviews
item.description: A practical nursing resume guide — structure, licenses and certifications, specialty keywords for applicant tracking systems, bullet formulas and new-grad examples.

item.title: Personal Finance for Nurses: Overtime, Pensions, Retirement Accounts and Debt (US & Canada)
item.description: A practical money guide for nurses — reading your pay stub, using overtime wisely, emergency funds, workplace pensions and retirement accounts in the US and Canada, student loans and insurance.

item.title: Remote and Non-Bedside Nursing Jobs: 12 Paths and How to Land One
item.description: Remote and non-bedside nursing careers — telephone triage, case management, utilization review, informatics, clinical documentation integrity, education and more — with the experience and licences employers expect.

item.title: Travel Nursing 101: Contracts, Stipends, Licenses and Red Flags
item.description: How travel nursing works — eligibility, 13-week contracts, pay packages and stipends, tax-home basics, compact licenses, choosing an agency, and contract red flags. Includes notes for Canadian nurses.
